description: Source code for Odoo modules related to account analytic accounts, journals, and their integration, including class definitions, methods, and database interactions.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Model representing analytic accounts with methods for calculations and hierarchy management.

classes.name: account_analytic_journal
classes.description: Model for analytic journals, defining journal types and lines.

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Inherited model extending account.journal with a link to analytic journals.

methods.name: _credit_calc
methods.description: Calculates total credit for analytic accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _debit_calc
methods.description: Calculates total debit for analytic accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _balance_calc
methods.description: Computes the balance of analytic accounts, including child accounts and currency conversions.

methods.name: _quantity_calc
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for analytic accounts, including child accounts.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display names for analytic accounts, including hierarchy.

methods.name: _complete_name_calc
methods.description: Generates full account name with hierarchy.

methods.name: _get_company_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency of the associated company.

methods.name: check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive parent-child relationships in accounts.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new analytic account, assigning a sequence code if not provided.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates an analytic account, resetting code and lines.

methods.name: on_change_parent
methods.description: Updates account code and partner when parent account changes.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches accounts by code or name, including hierarchy.
